full_judgment: 2. Petitioners instituted the above suit for partition on declaration of their title. Their case, in short, is that they are the successive heirs of Herajtullah, one of the original Owners of C.S. Khatian Nos. 384/1614 under Chourhash mouja. Some lands of the said mouja were sold in auction in Money Execution Case No. 1417 of 1925 and Delbar Sheikh, the original plaintiff No. 1 and one Asgar Sheikh purchased the said lands in auction and took delivery of possession through Court. The remaining 2/3rd portion of the said lands was purchased by Asgar Ali Sheikh from the heirs of Abu Sheikh. The plaintiffs got 7 annas and odd share in Khatian Nos. 348 and 1614 and .15 acres in Khatian No. 305. In this way they have been possessing 1.18 acres of land. Abdul Gani, son of Asgar Sheikh transferred his share to the predecessors of the defendants who are men of disparate character. The plaintiffs requested the defendants to make an amicable partition of the suit lands which they refused.
